steps.en: Install from a clone, then answer the wizard's interest questions — it writes data/config.json
steps.zh: 克隆后安装，再回答向导的兴趣问题——它生成 data/config.json

steps.en: Put your model key in .env — an env-var name, never the secret itself, goes in the config
steps.zh: 把模型 API key 写进 .env——配置里只写环境变量名，不写密钥本身

steps.en: Start one run over the last 24 hours (or schedule it via cron / GitHub Actions)
steps.zh: 手动跑一次最近 24 小时的流水线（或用 cron 定时）

steps.en: Pull the window's items from every configured source — RSS, Hacker News, Reddit, Telegram…
steps.zh: 抓取所有配置源在时间窗内的条目——RSS、HN、Reddit 等

steps.en: Route each item to a profile, score it 0–10, drop below-threshold items, merge repeat stories
steps.zh: 路由到 profile，按 0–10 打分，低于阈值丢弃，重复合并

steps.en: Enrich survivors with background and top comments, write the English + Chinese briefing
steps.zh: 补背景与热门评论摘要，写出中英双语简报

value.en: A briefing that reads handpicked in two languages — you stop opening twenty feeds a day
value.zh: 每天读到一份像人工精选过的双语简报——不用再开二十个订阅源
